remarks: The equipment records list these AHUs and the pressurisation unit as 1 x 100 %; see findings
text: Air handling units serving the control room, the electronic rooms, the MV and LV rooms and the UPS rooms shall have N+1 provisions in fans (a fan wall with n+1 fans or duty / standby fans with automatic changeover), power supply and controls, so that a single failure does not interrupt the cooling and the pressurisation; the coils may be single provided they are split in two independent circuits; the pressurisation fan of the control building shall have a standby fan (equipment records 00SAA11AN001 to 005 and 008: 2 x 100 % supply fans).
